register.labelZh: ZONE AND ZONK 片語動詞的實際用途
register.labelEn: ZONE AND ZONK Phrasal Verbs in Use
register.summaryZh: zone something off 可以描述劃作行人、單車、食物攤檔、的士或其他特定用途的範圍。；zone out 可以描述你仍然清醒,卻暫時沒有留意周圍事情的情況。；zone out 通常與注意力有關;zonk out 則表示真正睡着或失去知覺。；zonk out 和 zonk somebody out 可以生動地描述某人累得無法保持清醒。
register.summaryEn: Zone something off can describe an area reserved for pedestrians, bicycles, food stalls, taxis or another particular use. Zone out helps you describe moments when you are still awake but no longer notice what is happening around you. Zone out normally concerns attention, while zonk out describes actually falling asleep or becoming unconscious. Zonk out and zonk somebody out provide lively, informal ways to describe someone becoming too tired to remain awake.
